title: Russian Translation Pack
description: Russian localization resource pack for some mods and addons.
body:
# Russian Translation Pack

Russian Translation Pack is a resource pack that adds and improves Russian localization for mods and addons.

The pack focuses on natural, readable Russian translations instead of raw machine-translated text. It covers item and block names, tooltips, Create-style Shift descriptions, UI text, categories, ponder text, and various mod-specific messages.

## Supported Mods

- Create: The Factory Must Grow
- Create: Food
- Create: Big Cannons
- CBC Military Supplement
- Create Deco
- Create: New Age
- Create: Radars
- Create: Tweaked Controllers
- Alloyed
- Hot Kettles
- Protection Pixel
- Farmer's Delight

## Notes

- Mod names are intentionally kept in English.
- Some technical terms are adapted for clarity and consistency.
- The pack may include small client-side resource fixes required to prevent broken mod resources from disabling the pack.
